name: Send a Text Message
description: Help the user send a text message or iMessage
prompt: The user wants to send a text message. FIRST ask who they want to message and whether they have the person's phone number. Once you know the recipient, THEN guide them through opening the Messages app, starting a new conversation, and sending. Offer to help compose the message if they want. Mention the difference between green (SMS) and blue (iMessage) bubbles on iPhone if relevant.
